preprocess: RGB Resize(shorter edge 256, bicubic), CenterCrop224, ImageNet normalize
latent: postGELU final MLP, full ordered 600x768, no pooling or PCA
architecture: flatten full 600x768 -> hidden32 or64 ->256 ->384, GELU and dropout; no pooling/PCA/SD
loss: cosine + .1 standardized target residual MSE + .1 InfoNCE(all240 training DINO features, temperature .07)
selection: validation top1, then top5, then cosine; test only after selecting
